cancellation_summary: You may cancel up to 72 hours in advance for a full refund or up to the start of the charter with Trip Protection
location_address: 74-425 Kealakehe Pkwy, Kailua-Kona, HI 96740 Kailua-Kona, HI US 96740
description: Blackwater diving is a unique night dive which will take you miles offshore where you will hang, suspended from a 60ft tether, over 4000ft of water to watch open ocean, or pelagic, animals drift by. You’ll have the opportunity to see animals ranging from perfectly clear larval fish and invertebrates to siphonophores, and even cephalopods out in the deep. If you want to observe something you have never seen before, this is the dive for you.
itinerary:
- Departure from Honokohau Marina
- 60ft tether suspension to observe pelagic animals in the deep ocean
- Return to shore
highlights:
- Unique blackwater night dive experience
- Chance to see rare pelagic creatures, including siphonophores and cephalopods
- Dive over 4000ft of water
check_in_details:
Arrive at scheduled time!
No need to come to the shop! Sign Your Waiver Online & Meet us at the boat in the harbor
special_requirements:
- Must be in good health with no heart conditions
- Minimum of 50 logged dives
- Must have dived within the last 6 months
restrictions: - Must have excellent buoyancy skills and be self-reliant
disclaimers:
- We reserve the right to cancel dives if safety standards are not met
- Mineral sunscreens only; toxic sunscreens are prohibited
faqs:
- **Do I need to have 50 logged dives?** Yes, this dive requires at least 50 logged dives.
- **What if I arrive late?** We depart on time, and no refunds are given for late arrivals.
